teacher.createCourseFirst: Create a course first — problems belong to a course.
teacher.checkerLabel: How should the output be judged?

checkerHelp.exact: Output must match character for character. Pick another option if the answer involves decimals or has no fixed order.
checkerHelp.float: Numbers are compared numerically, so 0.30000000000000004 counts as 0.3.
checkerHelp.regex: The expected output of each test case is treated as a regular expression the whole output must match.
checkerHelp.other: Whitespace and ordering differences are ignored where the option says so.

similarity.title: Similarity Report
similarity.disclaimerBefore: This is a screening tool, not a verdict. Short exercises often have only one or two reasonable solutions, so some baseline similarity across the whole class is normal and expected. A pair is only flagged as
similarity.disclaimerAfter: when it sits well above what the rest of the class produced on its own — always review the highlighted code yourself before drawing any conclusion.
similarity.notEnough: Not enough submissions in the same language yet to compare.
